2085-4613-6857.easyPrerequisites:
Kragma Butcher doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Kelpie Guide is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
2085-4613-6857.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2085-4613-6857.description:
Activate Kragma Butcher using Kelpie Guide's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Kelpie Guide's ability by tapping it, untapping Kragma Butcher
Kragma Butcher triggers, giving it +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2921-4550-5567-8298--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
2921-4550-5567-8298--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

413-1981-2741.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
413-1981-2741.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Essence Warden trigger.
Resolve the Essence Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

654-1021-5411-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, giving a creature haste until end of turn.
Repeat.

1339-2835-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2835-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4676-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Elegant Edgecrafters.
When Elegant Edgecrafters dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Elegant Edgecrafters enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
4676-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-6972-7229.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power X or greater, or you have a creature card in your graveyard with power X or greater.
4247-6972-7229.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Ambitious Dragonborn.
When Ambitious Dragonborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

3899-5170-6132-7918.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

215-955-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
215-955-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-955-5457.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

620-3532-5078-7753.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
620-3532-5078-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7727.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Hulk.
When Hulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1636-7325-7426.description:
Activate Berta by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on the Fractal.
When the Fractal enters, Mighty Mutanimals and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Mighty Mutanimals trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1640-7407.easyPrerequisites: Inviolability and Pariah's Shield are attached to the same creature.
1640-7407.description:
Whenever damage would be dealt to you, Pariah's Shield causes that damage to be redirected to the creature it is attached to.
Since Inviolability grants an ability to the creature preventing damage being dealt to it, no damage is dealt to you or to that creature.

67-1086-1676-5670-6917.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
67-1086-1676-5670-6917.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Seedship Broodtender and Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. Boss's Chauffeur will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it equal to the number of creatures you control.
When Seedship Broodtender enters, it, Anointer Priest and Boss's Chauffeur trigger.
Resolve the Anointer Priest trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the Seedship Broodtender trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Citizens enter, Anointer Priest triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a Citizen, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 12 two additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{G}.
Activate Seedship Broodtender by paying {3}{B}{G} and sacrificing it, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reveillark enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
67-1086-1676-5670-6917.notes: You must control an additional creature to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur, infinite mana, infinite lifegain, and infinite creature tokens.

907-1399-1606-5396.description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

4215-5231-6730.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, moving any counters from it onto another creature you control, and then shuffling Sin into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Sin and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
4215-5231-6730.notes: In order to get infinite +1/+1 counters, remove as many counters as possible when Sin enters, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin as it enters. Those counters can then be moved to another creature when Sin dies.

2054-3525-4131-6657.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {6} and tapping it, copying Basalt Monolith's ability three times.
Resolve a copy of Basalt Monolith's ability, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate Urn of Godfire by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Gogo.
Repeat from step 3.

4826-5531-6620-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
4826-5531-6620-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.

813-933-6103-6492.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, allowing you to decide how each player votes this turn and causing you to draw a a card.
Cast Plea for Power by paying {3}{U}, choosing all votes to be for time, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Illusion of Choice and Plea for Power from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

643-1789-2438-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

710-1052-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

4125-5733-6122.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
4125-5733-6122.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Shipwreck Dowser by paying its mana cost.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Shipwreck Dowser from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

147-167-2292.description:
Cost Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it and the Wicked Role token attached to it trigger.
Resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Repeat from step 7.

64-2665-5733.notablePrerequisites:
Progenitor Mimic on the battlefield as a copy of Warden of the Eye.
You control at least one Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
64-2665-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye.
When the Warden of the Eye token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

121-1172-1624.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

1109-1636-2034-2263.notablePrerequisites:
Skeleton Ship does not have summoning sickness.
Geralf's Mindcrusher does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1109-1636-2034-2263.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher, adding {C}{C}.
Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Geralf's Mindcrusher enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Geralf's Mindcrusher trigger, causing target player to mill five cards.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Skeleton Ship by tapping it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Geralf's Mindcrusher.
Repeat.

654-2248-3478-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Skyshroud Ranger.
Skyshroud Ranger does not have summoning sickness.
654-2248-3478-4222.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger from step 2, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.

1120-1218-1819.notablePrerequisites: You have at least ten creature cards in your graveyard.
1120-1218-1819.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Syr Konrad +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Activate Feldon's Cane by tapping and exiling it, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card that left your graveyard this way, giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

1329-1636-3693.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1636-3693.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Walking Ballista from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

914-5128-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Dockside Extortionist in graveyard with a sticker on it.
Your opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-5128-5147.description:
Activate Scampire by paying {3}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Dockside Extortionist triggers, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Sacrifice four Treasure tokens to add {3}{B}.
Sacrifice Dockside Extortionist to Goblin Bombardment, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
